GOGPT's prior 'Az Zour North power plant' (4,332 MW, tagged captive=True, 1.72km away) is Kuwait's giant Az-Zour North IWPP (five 225.8 MW GE 9F-3 gas turbines + two 251 MW steam turbines, per power-technology.com), operated by a separate utility JV under MEW. Its currently-operating Phase I burns pipeline natural gas delivered by KOC via a dedicated 40in pipeline, NOT regasified LNG from this terminal — only the planned Phase II/III expansion (construction from 2026) is designed to use LNG as its primary fuel, with gas oil as backup. So today this GOGPT plant is neither fed by, nor captive to, this LNG terminal; if Phase II/III LNG-firing goes ahead the relationship would still run terminal-to-plant (a PowerPlantsSupplied case for a future batch), not plant-to-terminal. This terminal itself is grid-fed with no captive generation of its own.
